articles.title: REPLAY: Macron addresses Ukraine, Greenland at NATO summit
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron told reporters at the NATO summit that he does not believe the US would seize Greenland, and addressed the war in Ukraine and Iran.

articles.title: Why are Macron's aviator glasses in the spotlight again?
articles.summary: The French president was again spotted wearing sunglasses indoors, examining the reasons behind his eyewear choice and its cultural significance regarding France's eyewear.

articles.title: Macron in Syria on first post-Assad visit by West European head of state
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron arrived in Damascus on July 6 for the first visit by a Western European head of state since Syria's new authorities took power, meeting with President Ahmed al-Sharaa.

articles.title: Replay: French President Emmanuel Macron speaks after Damascus blasts
articles.summary: Macron held a press conference with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa during his landmark Damascus visit after two bombs exploded near his hotel.

articles.title: Macron's 'Versailles diplomacy' yields mixed results after a decade in power
articles.summary: Emmanuel Macron hosted a G7 summit at the Palace of Versailles in June 2026, where he hosted US President Donald Trump, though analysts noted his grand diplomatic gestures have not always yielded lasting strategic influence.
